champion.tips: ELISE TIPS AND TRICKS Avoid spamming your W to poke. It costs a lot of mana, and you’ll be unable to commit to an all-in when you’re low on mana. Act like a Jungler! Roam around the map after winning bot lane and look to make plays elsewhere on the map. Do not be afraid to make plays or go for 1v1s in the mid and late game. Elise deals a lot of burst damage and can easily take down carries if she lands her Human E.
champion.builds: THE BEST ELISE BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Elise Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Electrocute as your keystone, followed by Sudden Impact, Deep Ward and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Coup de Grace and Triumph in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Bloodsong as your first item, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes and Stormsurge. For your last 3 items, you should build Shadowflame, Zhonya's Hourglass and finish with Rabadon's Deathcap. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - W - E. Right now, this build has 53.2% winrate over 9 492 matches played. Optional Your second option for Elise Support build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Electrocute as your keystone, Sudden Impact, Deep Ward and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Coup de Grace with Triumph in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Stormsurge as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Shadowflame, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 51.4% win rate over 2 809 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Dark Harvest as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, and Coup de Grace with Triumph in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Bloodsong as your first item, then Sorcerer's Shoes as a second item and Stormsurge as a third item. You want to finish the build with Shadowflame, Zhonya's Hourglass and Rabadon's Deathcap. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - W - E. This build is currently sitting at a 56.8% win rate across 1 529 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Elise Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, First Strike, Cash Back, Biscuit Delivery and Jack Of All Trades as your primary rune tree, and Treasure Hunter with Sudden Impact as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Bloodsong as your first item, then finish Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item, and Stormsurge as third item. The last 3 options are Shadowflame, Zhonya's Hourglass and Void Staff. The ability order for this build is Q - W - E. As of the current patch, this build has a 57.6% win rate over 66 matches played. Situational Elise Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Elise build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Elise runes page.
